en.infoDescription: Configure official plugins and install or manage other plugins here. View the built-in plugin list and runtime status in Settings → Built-in plugins.
en.installApplyingCancellationError: Cancellation was not confirmed. Installation is being applied; wait for its result. {reason}
en.installAttempt: {previous} could not serve the package; retrying through {registry} (registry {index} of {total})
en.installAwaitingAcceptance: Waiting for the Host to accept installation. Cancellation will retry automatically after confirmation.
en.installBackgroundApplying: Installation is being applied and cannot be cancelled. View installation progress.
en.installBackgroundUnconfirmed: Installation status is unconfirmed. View the installation for details.
en.installBackgroundUnknown: Installation result unavailable. Check the plugin list.
en.installCancelAndEdit: Cancel installation and return to editing
en.installFailureNetworkAll: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}). Check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry and retry.
en.installFailureNetworkHost: {host} could not be reached. A GitHub address or a .tgz link is not fetched through the registry: this machine must reach it directly or through a proxy. If the plugin is also published to npm, enter its package name instead.
en.installGitTemplateHint: Replace this with the actual Git repository address.
en.installPathTemplateHint: Replace this with the actual path to your local plugin directory.
en.installProblemNetworkAll: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}); check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry
en.installProblemShipped: This plugin ships with DSH; upgrading DSH updates it
en.installResultUnconfirmed: The installation result was not received. Check installation status. {reason}
en.installUnknownDescription: The Host has no active installation with this request id. Check the plugin list before trying again.
en.installUpgradeNotice: Installed plugins do not update automatically yet. To upgrade a plugin, uninstall it and install the new version. Later releases will keep improving the upgrade experience.
en.reasonIncompatibleInstall: Install a plugin version compatible with this DSH.
en.reasonIncompatibleInstalled: Uninstall it and install a version compatible with this DSH.
en.reasonIncompatibleVersion: {plugin} is incompatible with DSH {runtime} (requires {peers}); running it may cause crashes or data loss.
en.reasonIncompatibleVersionUnnamed: This plugin is incompatible with the running DSH version; running it may cause crashes or data loss.
en.registryCustomHint: Enter an internal or private npm registry address starting with http:// or https://. If it requires a login, store the credentials in ~/.npmrc on this machine.
en.registryCustomInvalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
en.registryLegend: The npm registry the plugin is downloaded from

zh.infoDescription: 在这里配置官方插件，安装和管理其他插件。内置插件列表及运行状态可在「设置 → 内置插件」中查看
zh.installApplyingCancellationError: 取消请求未得到确认；安装已进入收尾阶段，请等待结果。{reason}
zh.installAttempt: {previous} 不可用，正在改用 {registry} 重试（第 {index} 个源，共 {total} 个）
zh.installAwaitingAcceptance: 正在等待后端接收安装任务，收到确认后会自动重试取消。
zh.installBackgroundApplying: 安装已进入收尾阶段，无法取消，可查看安装进度。
zh.installBackgroundDone: 插件安装已完成，可查看安装结果。
zh.installBackgroundFailed: 插件安装失败，可查看安装详情。
zh.installBackgroundUnconfirmed: 安装状态暂未确认，请查看安装任务了解详情。
zh.installBackgroundUnknown: 未能获取安装结果，请检查插件列表。
zh.installFailureNetworkAll: 所有安装源都无法连接（已尝试：{registries}）。请检查网络或代理设置，或更换安装源后重试。
zh.installFailureNetworkHost: 无法连接 {host}。GitHub 地址和 .tgz 直链不经过安装源，需要本机能直接访问它或配置代理；如果这个插件也发布到了 npm，请改填包名。
zh.installGitTemplateHint: 请替换为实际的 Git 仓库地址
zh.installPathTemplateHint: 请替换为本机插件目录的实际路径
zh.installProblemNetworkAll: 所有安装源都无法连接（已尝试：{registries}），请检查网络或代理设置，或更换安装源
zh.installProblemShipped: 该插件随 DSH 提供，升级 DSH 即可获得新版本
zh.installResultUnconfirmed: 未收到安装结果，请核对安装状态。{reason}
zh.installUnknownDescription: 后端当前没有此安装任务。请检查插件列表后再尝试安装。
zh.installUpgradeNotice: 插件安装后，暂不支持自动更新。若需升级，请先卸载再安装新版，后续版本会持续改善升级体验。
zh.reasonIncompatibleInstall: 请安装与当前 DSH 兼容的插件版本。
zh.reasonIncompatibleInstalled: 请卸载后重新安装与当前 DSH 兼容的版本。
zh.reasonIncompatibleVersion: {plugin} 与 DSH {runtime} 不兼容（要求 {peers}），运行它可能导致崩溃或数据丢失。
zh.reasonIncompatibleVersionUnnamed: 这个插件与当前 DSH 版本不兼容，运行它可能导致崩溃或数据丢失。
zh.registryCustomHint: 填写内网或私有 npm 源地址，以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。若为需要登录的源，请把凭据放在本机的 ~/.npmrc 里。
zh.registryCustomInvalid: 请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的地址
zh.registryLegend: 从哪个 npm 源下载插件
